section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. This comparison was run at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 4. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 185 | 650 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Side effects | 180 | 650 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
